Class SocketServerProxy

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.network.socket.SocketServerProxy
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerProxy, VirtualServer
public class SocketServerProxy extends Object implements ServerProxy
Socket-based proxy on the client side.

Inbound (server → client): a dedicated reader thread listens on the TCP stream, decodes each newline-delimited JSON message, and dispatches it to the ClientNetworkDispatcher via the IoC Event.apply(it.polimi.ingsw.am02.common.interfaces.VirtualView) pattern. PingEvents are answered immediately with a PongCommand.

Outbound (client → server): Commands are serialized and written to the socket's output stream on the caller's thread; the stream is backed by an auto-flush PrintWriter so no explicit flush is needed.

Keep-alive uses a bidirectional ping-pong mechanism symmetric to RMI: the server pings the client (PingEvent → PongCommand) and the client pings the server (PingCommand → PongEvent). Each side resets its liveness timer only on receipt of the corresponding pong, not on generic traffic.

  • Method Details

    • setClientController

      public void setClientController(ClientController controller)
      Wires this proxy to the given ClientController and creates the ClientNetworkDispatcher that routes inbound server notifications to the appropriate client-side model.

      Must be called before ServerProxy.connect() so that inbound events are dispatched correctly as soon as the connection is live.

      Also registers a callback on the dispatcher so that activeGameId is updated whenever a game-started notification arrives.

      Specified by:
      setClientController in interface ServerProxy
      Parameters:
      controller - the client controller that owns the active model

    • connect

      public void connect() throws Exception
      Establishes the physical connection to the server.

      For RMI, performs the registry lookup and exports this object as a remote stub. For Socket, opens the TCP connection and starts the reader and ping threads. Must be called after ServerProxy.setClientController(ClientController) and before any outbound request is issued.

      Specified by:
      connect in interface ServerProxy
      Throws:
      Exception - if the connection cannot be established

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect()
      Closes the connection and releases all associated resources (threads, sockets, RMI stubs).

      Implementations must set an intentional-disconnect flag so that background threads do not trigger an automatic reconnection attempt.

      Specified by:
      disconnect in interface ServerProxy

      public boolean isConnected()

      Specified by:

      Returns:

      public void requestReconnect(String nickname, String gameId)
      Requests reconnection to an ongoing game.

      Also updates activeNickname, activeGameId, and the dispatcher's internal state so that the reconnection loop can replay this call after a network failure.
